title: Missing-Items Violation Disputes on Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
**Rule.** On Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts, a missing-items dispute that stands submitted is decided by the agent on the records of the disputed violation's batch, and the decision removes from that violation its missing-items excusal points, booked as one cleared entry with removal reason "dispute upheld". The dispute is marked upheld when the cleared entry is booked.

## What the records show before and after

| | Before the decision | After the decision |
|---|---|---|
| The dispute | Stands submitted | Upheld |
| The disputed violation | Recorded with its points | Carries one cleared entry for the excusal points, reason dispute upheld |
| Active violation points | As before | Lower by the excusal points |

## Tool: `decide_missing_items_dispute_36c35ef8`

**Capability.** Decides a shopper's submitted dispute of a missing-items violation in the shopper's favour and takes the given number of violation points off that violation. One call books one cleared entry against the disputed violation with removal reason `dispute_upheld` and the points removed, lowers the account's active violation points by the same number, and marks the dispute as upheld.

**How it is invoked.** The agent unlocks `decide_missing_items_dispute_36c35ef8` and then calls it; it is an agent-side tool.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `shopper_account_id` | The shopper contractor account number the dispute belongs to, as returned by the shopper account lookup for the verified caller | Account reference, text |
| `shopper_appeal_id` | The reference number of the submitted violation dispute being decided, as returned by the shopper appeals lookup | Dispute reference, text |
| `source_event_id` | The reference number of the disputed missing-items violation entry, as shown on the dispute and in the shopper account entries lookup | Entry reference, text |
| `points` | The violation points taken off the disputed violation | A whole non-negative integer, no decimals, no sign; the active points fall by exactly this integer |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` ("dispute_upheld" when the decision was booked), `clearing_entry_id` (the reference of the new cleared entry), `shopper_appeal_id` and `source_event_id` (echoed back), `points_removed` (the integer taken off), `violation_points_balance` (the active violation points after the decision) and `event_date` (the decision date, YYYY-MM-DD).
